scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker exec localstack-vms-ifx bash -c "until awslocal dynamodb list-tables >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; bash /etc/localstack/init/ready.d/init-aws.sh"
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
